Estate: 18 ha (11 Cabernet Franc, 7 Chenin Blanc), clay/flint, ~62,000 bottles/year; 2024 gave 48,000 after May hail cut a fifth of western plots. Organic since 2019; biodynamic conversion began 2023, earliest certification 2026. Exports 41%, mainly Belgium and Japan; Japan requires sulphites under 60 mg/L.

Incidents: 2022 tank 4 controller drifted 3°C, losing aromatics (€11,000 bulk loss) — now calibrated pre-harvest with a second probe. 2023 label error recalled 900 bottles — proofs need two signatures.

Rules: no irrigation on western plots; harvest decided by three mornings of sugar/acidity data; tanks above 28°C cooled within four hours.

Open: lighter bottles (importer unconfirmed, no cost comparison); eastern parcel replanting after 2027 undecided (54-year-old vines, yields down 30%).
